queue_item_id.description: Matches MAT-4 queue.items[].id for the blocked_hitl item.

repo_profile_identity_id.description: Optional; when set, matches MAT-9 identity.id / MAT-4 repo_profile.identity_id.

orchestrator_state_path.description: Optional repo-relative path to the orchestrator state file (e.g. orchestrator.state.json) for multi-worktree routing.

expected_queue_status.description: Documented gate: orchestrator SHOULD set MAT-4 queue item status to blocked_hitl before emitting this trigger.

title.description: Asana task title and human-facing summary line.

body.description: Longer rationale, links to artifacts, or review notes for the approver.

project_gid.description: Create a top-level task in this project when parent_task_gid is absent.

parent_task_gid.description: Create a subtask under this parent when automation prefers hierarchy over project_gid.

approval_section_gid.description: Optional board column or section gid to place the task after creation.

sla_due_at.description: Optional due time for the approval task or automation reminder.

schema_version.description: Bump only when this trigger wire format changes.

uuid.description: RFC 4122 UUID; SHOULD match MAT-4 queue.items[].correlation_id when that field is set.

repo_relative_path.description: Path relative to repo root; aligned with MAT-9 / MAT-4 path rules.
